title: SpiderCat: Optimal Fault-Tolerant Cat State Preparation
summary: The ability to fault-tolerantly prepare CAT states, also known as multi-qubit GHZ states, is an important primitive for quantum error correction. It is required for Shor-style syndrome extraction, and can also be used as a subroutine for doing fault-tolerant state preparation of CSS codewords. Existing approaches to fault-tolerant CAT state preparations have been found using computationally expensive heuristics involving SAT solving, reinforcement learning, or exhaustive analysis.
